coins.name: Bitcoin
coins.why: BTC is the core of the portfolio: held for the long run, through market cycles, with no stop. The plan is 30% of the portfolio: if its share falls below ¾ of the plan, the system buys more; if it grows past 1.5 times the plan, it sells the extra. Bitcoin gets the biggest share: in 2025–2026 it fell less than Ether and Solana.

calc.spot_why: Spot is the CRYPTO NOVA portfolio, with no leverage. The core — Bitcoin 30%, Ether 10%, Solana 5% — is held for the long run; coins the table marks «can buy» get 7.5% each with a −20% stop; risky ones 2.5% each; at least 10% stays in dollars. At most 8 coins including the core. Another 10% of the account is extra core: BTC, ETH and SOL in the same 30 / 10 / 5 proportions.
calc.cash_why: The system always keeps at least 10% of the portfolio in dollars: that is what it uses to top up the core in dips.
calc.active_why: Active spot is «BTC momentum»: when Bitcoin rises 2.5% or more in an hour, the system buys the most liquid altcoins on spot — they usually catch up. No leverage, up to 5 positions, exit after 12 hours. Between trades this part waits in BTC; after an exit it stays in dollars for up to 3 days, until a new signal.
calc.futures_why: Futures are CRYPTO NOVA's selected signals: only strategies that passed the test on history trade this account. Every trade has a stop; the risk is 1% of the futures budget per trade, and the main strategy holds no more than 4 trades at once. Losses happen too: the stop closes a losing trade. CRYPTO NOVA's real account since 22 Oct 2026: 5 futures trades closed, 1 of them in profit.
